clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, Forsaken gather the skulls of slain humans. At Tarren Mill, they keep them as grim mementos of the assault on local settlements.

Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill fight the humans of Southshore and nearby settlements. During the Battle of Hillsbrad, Deathstalkers and soldiers carry out the purge Darthalia ordered. Guards left on watch want a share of the slaughter. Deathguard Samsa collects skulls from the fighters on the front lines, taking pleasure in keeping the remains of people the Forsaken once lived among. These trophies are proof of the killing as the conflict rages.
